nodes.description: Ownable._owner: private address storing the contract owner set at construction and used by the onlyOwner guard.
Receiver.dev1: payable developer address receiving a share of every incoming ether payment.
Receiver.dev2: payable developer address receiving a share of every incoming ether payment.
Receiver.divamount1: uint8 divisor used to compute dev1's share of msg.value; writable by owner, can be set to 0.
Receiver.divamount2: uint8 divisor used to compute dev2's share of msg.value; writable by owner, can be set to 0.
Context._msgSender(): internal view returning the raw msg.sender address.
Ownable constructor: sets _owner to the deployer obtained through _msgSender().
Ownable.transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner-guarded ownership transfer that validates non-zero address and delegates to _setOwner.
Ownable._setOwner(address): private state-changing helper that writes _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
onlyOwner modifier: access-control guard requiring _owner == _msgSender().
Receiver constructor: stores both developer addresses and initialises both divisors to 2.
Receiver.receive(): payable fallback that splits msg.value between dev1 and dev2 using the stored divisors.
Receiver.changeDivideAmount(uint8,uint8): onlyOwner setter for divamount1 and divamount2, accepts zero.
Receiver.changeDevAddresses(address,address): onlyOwner setter replacing both developer payout addresses.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and owner initialisation.
dev1.transfer(amount / divamount1): external ether push whose amount depends on owner-controlled divisor, may revert on division by zero.
dev2.transfer(amount / divamount2): external ether push whose amount depends on owner-controlled divisor, may revert on division by zero.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership(address), the prospective owner address.
newOwner parameter of the private _setOwner(address) helper.
oldOwner local: snapshot of _owner read before being overwritten in _setOwner.
_dev1 parameter of the Receiver constructor, initial developer1 payout address.
_dev2 parameter of the Receiver constructor, initial developer2 payout address.
amount local: copy of msg.value inside receive().
newamount1 parameter of changeDivideAmount, new value written to divamount1.
newamount2 parameter of changeDivideAmount, new value written to divamount2.
newdev1 parameter of changeDevAddresses, new value written to dev1.
newdev2 parameter of changeDevAddresses, new value written to dev2.
msgSender local: cached result of _msgSender() in the Ownable constructor.

edges.reason: _msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
Ownable constructor stores the _msgSender() result into the msgSender local.
The msgSender local is written into the _owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares _owner against the caller returned by _msgSender().
The require in onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable as the authority reference.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of changeDivideAmount.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of changeDevAddresses.
The newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership and passed to _setOwner.
transferOwnership calls the private _setOwner helper.
The newOwner parameter is the value assigned inside _setOwner.
_setOwner reads the current _owner into the oldOwner local before overwriting.
oldOwner is used when emitting OwnershipTransferred inside _setOwner.
_setOwner writes the newOwner parameter into the _owner state variable.
Receiver constructor assigns the _dev1 parameter to dev1.
Receiver constructor assigns the _dev2 parameter to dev2.
Receiver constructor initialises divamount1 to 2.
Receiver constructor initialises divamount2 to 2.
receive() executes the dev1.transfer external call.
receive() executes the dev2.transfer external call.
The amount local (msg.value) is the dividend of the dev1 transfer.
The amount local (msg.value) is the dividend of the dev2 transfer.
dev1.transfer divides by the owner-controlled divamount1, which may be zero and cause an arithmetic panic.
dev2.transfer divides by the owner-controlled divamount2, which may be zero and cause an arithmetic panic.
dev1 is the destination address of the first ether transfer.
dev2 is the destination address of the second ether transfer.
changeDivideAmount writes newamount1 into divamount1.
changeDivideAmount writes newamount2 into divamount2.
changeDevAddresses writes newdev1 into dev1.
changeDevAddresses writes newdev2 into dev2.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter newOwner only exists to feed transferOwnership and should be folded into that core function.
Parameter newOwner is the assignment source inside _setOwner and should be folded into that core function.
Local oldOwner is a temporary snapshot used only inside _setOwner and should be folded into it.
Constructor parameter _dev1 is only used to initialise dev1 in the Receiver constructor.
Constructor parameter _dev2 is only used to initialise dev2 in the Receiver constructor.
Local amount is just msg.value inside receive() and should be folded into that core function.
Parameter newamount1 is only consumed by changeDivideAmount when writing divamount1.
Parameter newamount2 is only consumed by changeDivideAmount when writing divamount2.
Parameter newdev1 is only consumed by changeDevAddresses when writing dev1.
Parameter newdev2 is only consumed by changeDevAddresses when writing dev2.
Local msgSender exists only inside the Ownable constructor and should be folded into it.
